# Persistence

The projection database stores sessions, events and the knowledge index in one SQLite file.

## Migration

A migration runs inside a transaction. If it fails the whole block rolls back and the version row is not written.

# Retrieval scoring

Lexical and semantic recall each carry a fixed weight of 0.35. Freshness and user feedback are worth 0.05 each.

# Memory service

The host validates the scope and the TTL. A model may only propose a candidate, and a human decides what becomes active.

# Dream maintenance

Maintenance runs only when both the interval and the idle window have elapsed. A crash leaves the previous run marked interrupted.

# Telemetry

A retrieval event stores an opaque digest of the query instead of the raw text.
Weekly meeting cadence notes. Nothing on this page mentions the measurement tool by name.

# Glossary

Unrelated body text that is present only so this file has a chunk at all.

# Retrieval history

A log of retrieval and scoring experiments that were later discarded. Kept here as a distractor so the recall channels have to rank, not merely match.
